versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D — UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
Each payload compartment must
(1) Be designed for the maximum weight and distribution of contents and for the critical load distributions at the appropriate maximum load factors corresponding to the flight and ground load conditions of USAR.
(2) Have means to prevent the contents of any compartment from becoming a hazard by shifting, and to protect any controls, wiring, lines, equipment, or accessories whose damage or failure would affect safe operations.
